main_text.p: potius quam specie differre: revera tamen intrinsecè, formaliter, & specificè ad invicem distinguuntur. Verum est illa distinctio, ob affinitatem, & finis in quem tenduntur, & vocum quibus expri-muntur,adeo fæpę obscura, ut difficile sit tria ista aut non penitus confundere, aut dextrè & peritè distinguere. Itaque quo melius isthæc internoscantur, quatuor mihi videntur esse confideranda, ex quibus velut criteriis de qualibet loquendi formulâ sitne Juramentum, an-Obte-statio, an Asseveratio tantùm, poterimus aliquatenus dijudicare. Forma sc. verborum, eorundem propria & genuinâ[?] vis, Mos gentis, & Intentio ipsius jurantis.
main_text.head: SECT. V.
main_text.p: Cafus 35Primo, ex ipsa verborum formâ quan-doque satis constare poterit, utrum juratum sit, vel non. Juro mihi te daturum centum. Juro: vel per Deum dabo: vel Deo teste aut coram Deo spondeo me daturum: vel Dabo, ita me Deus adjuvet aut aliquid simile si respondeatur, quia juratam sit nemini potest esse dubium. Obligatur proinde, qui istiusmodi aliqu[?]

page.notes: The right edge of every line is cut off by the scan, so line-final words are incomplete and the last letters of several lines are unreadable; they are not marked individually. Doubtful: "genuinâ" (edge-cropped), "aliqu" (edge-cropped, probably aliquid), "quia" (edge-cropped). "Cafus 35" is a left margin note, printed as such (probably Casus). The hyphenated "an-Obte-statio" keeps the printed hyphens. The printed page carries no foot note.
